Subject: Quick follow-up — EOQ timing and budget?

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to learn how StellarApps is thinking about adding LLM features to the product roadmap. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Use cases: in-app summarization + search reranking for enterprise customers (sensitive PII filtering required)
- Success criteria: average generation latency <200ms for single-turn prompts, throughput target ~200 req/s for peak, cost target to keep incremental inference spend under $X/month
- Compliance: need SOC 2 + audit logs and optional VPC/private deployment for production data

Next steps we agreed on: 
1) I’ll send a short mutual action plan and an initial cost/throughput estimate (attached).
2) Schedule a technical deep-dive with your infra/security folks to cover network/KMS and data flows.
3) Procurement: share SOW/terms for pilot so you can start internal approvals.

One quick question for planning: is end-of-quarter (EOQ) still the target for pilot approval/initial budget? If timing has shifted, no problem — just want to prioritize the right materials.

Proposed times for the technical deep-dive next week: Wed 3/31 10:00–11:00am PT or Thu 4/1 2:00–3:00pm PT. If neither works, tell me a couple of windows that do.

Attachment: mutual-action-plan-v1.pdf (PDF stub)

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
